_about: The instrument map (Core L-539 (1); Companion Part 161): which consequences of the Foundational Consequence Register each principal instrument rests on, and what it is used for. The register governs the order and jurisdiction of inquiry; each instrument keeps its own function and arithmetic. Checked by python3 tools/oef.py --consequences.

instruments.use: the coordinate places a question within the totality; it is the act of DC-13, and the instrument selection it carries decides which instruments a question calls (L-539 (2))
the Standing Record types a finding by where its truth lives
the Transduction Record translates a structure too large to show whole, since no view is the whole
the Foundational Congruence Record gives each principle its standing; the register's standings are its standings
the Constraint Boundary Register records the executor's limits, the executor being inside
the Nested Manifestation Record types the sense in which a part holds the whole
the Perspective and Consensus Register keeps shared constraint, interpretation, agreement and dissent apart
the Foundational Premise Integrity Scan finds the premise weakened or externalized
the Frame Intrusion Scan finds an outside court
a comparison of the coordinate with a decoy, an instrument-performance study in the COMPARATIVE mode; it does not test the premise
the correspondence family, optional, each result about its object (Appendix S; L-539 (5))
readings compared across architectures; convergence is comparative information and Collective Resonance, never a vote on standing
the conformance suite checks a Navigator against the protocol, its frame cases among them
an Applied Protocol Exploration names the consequences it addresses, with their kind and warrant
